_comment: Template only, the real answers.json is gitignored and lives on the faucet server. TWO per-lesson formats are accepted. (1) Legacy: a bare list of correct option letters, one per question, in order; each question is assumed to have options a, b, c (every current lesson does). (2) Explicit: an object with a questions[] array, required for a question bank or for anything other than three a/b/c options. Set serve to how many of the bank to show each attempt (omit to show all). The server shuffles which questions are asked and each one's option order per attempt, and never tells a failing user which answers were wrong, so answers cannot be memorised as a fixed sequence. The question bank and this lesson's quiz[] array in lessons.js are index-aligned and MUST be the same length per lesson.
